ابتنوا (form VIII)
# اِبْتَنَوْا (ibtanaw) /ib.ta.naw/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِبْتَنَى (ibtanā)
# اُبْتُنُوا (ubtunū) /ub.tu.nuː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِبْتَنَى (ibtanā)
# اِبْتَنُوا (ibtanū) /ib.ta.nuː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِبْتَنَى (ibtanā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
